newsitem.title: GERMANY: German avg jobless seen at 3.95 mln in '96, '97.
newsitem.headline: German avg jobless seen at 3.95 mln in '96, '97.

text.p: The German labour office said on Thursday the economy was not growing strong enough to curb unemployment significantly but the yearly average would be just under four million this year and next.

"Economic growth is not yet strong enough and based on our estimates and estimates from the government we expect average pan German unemployment to be around 3.95 million in 1996 and 1997," said Klaus Leven, labour office vice president.
German jobless figures topped the four million mark for the first time in October, according to seasonally adjusted data released by the labour office.
